instruction: The file `/home/user/Desktop/dense.brd` is the board to clean up. Its refdes placeholders (`>NAME`) are embedded in the element bodies. Move exactly five refdes out into free-standing text on layer `25` (`tNames`) in the board's `<plain>` block, then save the result as `/home/user/Desktop/labeled.brd`. Requirements: 1. `/home/user/Desktop/labeled.brd` parses as well-formed XML. 2. The board's `<plain>` block contains exactly 5 `<text layer="25">` elements. 3. Those five labels correspond to the five elements closest to the board's geometric center in the starter board. 4. Every moved label has content equal to an existing element refdes in the board, and no refdes is labeled more than once. 5. The element count is unchanged relative to the starter. 6. The set of element names is identical between the starter and the output. [Software] On Linux, launch CadSoft EAGLE with `/opt/eagle-7.7.0/bin/eagle` (adjust to your install).
